brief.headline: Blackstone data centre REIT strikes $5bn AWS deal
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust (BXDC) has agreed to acquire a 75% stake in two joint ventures with Amazon Web Services (AWS) in a transaction valued at about $5bn, according to a report by Bloomberg.

Regulation & Policy: Blackstone, Apollo Global Management and Pimco are seeking a larger share of the EU’s €10trn insurance asset market ahead of Solvency II reforms that could free up €80bn in regulatory capital based on insurers’ existing holdings, according to a Bloomberg report citing S&P Global Ratings.

Fed & Rates: Federal Reserve official Barr spoke on “Investing in America’s Underserved Communities” at Making Missing Markets: Catalyzing Capital and Igniting Innovation, Federal Reserve Bank of New York, New York, New York.
Hotels & Hospitality: Accor just committed $1.8 billion to buyout the minority investors in its Ennismore joint venture.

Investor Outlook: The global economy is forecast to grow 2.8% in 2027, though energy and AI could test its resilience, Jan Hatzius, chief economist and head of Goldman Sachs Research says on the Exchanges podcast.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: signals are mixed, with some markets calm and others showing strain, so expect selective risk-taking. The S&P 500 stands at 7,340.53 (down 1.0% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 25.5, an elevated reading that signals nervous markets. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.12% (down 3 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.30 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.43%, near long-run norms (up 9 bps on the prior reading).
